name: bgsc-backend
description: BGSC platform backend — API gateway (:3000) plus domain services under apps/.
//preselfcheck: ts-node does NOT apply tsconfig `paths` at runtime: Node resolves @bgsc/shared through the workspace symlink to packages/shared/dist, so every selfcheck and e2e runs against COMPILED shared code. Without these hooks, editing a shared model and running the suite tests the previous build — a changed invariant appears to pass before it exists.

scripts.dev: nodemon --watch src --watch packages/shared/src --ext ts --exec "tsc -p packages/shared && ts-node src/index.ts"
scripts.typecheck: npx -p typescript@7 tsc --build --force && npx -p typescript@7 tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.check.json && npm run build
scripts.test: npm run selfcheck && npm run e2e
scripts.//live-check: Full stack on the host against a dropped-and-rebuilt bgsc_live DB (needs compose mongodb + redis): every route through the gateway plus cross-service journeys. ~3 min. Output in scripts/live-check/.run/.
scripts.live-check: bash scripts/live-check/stack.sh && node scripts/live-check/run.js; s=$?; bash scripts/live-check/stop.sh; exit $s
scripts.//seed:founder: One-time bootstrap: promotes the registered, active account FOUNDER_EMAIL to founder. In the image: docker compose run --rm -e FOUNDER_EMAIL=... user-service node apps/user-service/dist/scripts/seed-founder.js

author: Rubber_Duck
